competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Lower reported spot volume, negative aggregate taker flow and ETF outflows are consistent with weakened spot demand.
evidence: CoinGlass net taker flow -$22.80M over 24 hours and -$210.02M over seven days.
Alpha Finance and SoSoValue-derived ETF series show recent outflows.
counterevidence: XRP Insights reports a positive November 13 flow when using six spot funds plus BITW and excluding GXRP from flow totals.
SwiftEdge reports positive taker and large-order net flows in a separate snapshot.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Falling open interest and negative funding across several derivatives views may indicate position reduction and short-side crowding rather than a simple one-way bearish signal.
evidence: Liqwall and TradRadar report lower open interest.
SwiftEdge reports lower open interest and negative funding.
counterevidence: Open-interest totals differ materially by provider and contract universe.
Negative funding and falling OI do not establish future price direction.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Displayed bid walls may be transient and cannot be treated as durable support.
evidence: SwiftEdge's displayed depth methodology warns that resting orders can be cancelled.
counterevidence: The provider reports sizable displayed bids near its quoted price.
